hooks.description: C# auto-format with dotnet format (on .cs edit)

hooks.command: echo '⚠ .meta ファイルを直接作成しようとしています。Unity Editor でアセットを追加すると自動生成されます。手動作成が本当に必要か確認してください。'
grep -n 'tex2D\|tex2Dlod\|discard' "$FILE" && echo '⚠ tex2D/discard found. Consider performance impact on mobile platforms.' || true
grep -n 'FindObjectOfType\|FindObjectsOfType\|GameObject.Find\|GetComponent' "$FILE" | head -5 && echo '⚠ Runtime Find/GetComponent detected. Consider caching references or using DI.' || true
hooks.description: Detect expensive Unity API calls (Find, GetComponent at runtime)

hooks.command: grep -n 'new List\|new Dictionary\|new HashSet\|string\.Concat\|\+.*string' "$FILE" | grep -v '// pool\|// cache\|// init\|Awake\|Start\|OnEnable' | head -5 && echo '⚠ Potential GC allocation in hot path. Consider object pooling or pre-allocation.' || true
hooks.description: Detect GC allocations in C# (new collections, string concat)

hooks.command: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep '\.cs$' | xargs grep -l 'Debug.Log' 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo '⚠ Debug.Log found in modified C# files. Remove or wrap with #if UNITY_EDITOR before release.' || true
hooks.description: Check for Debug.Log in modified C# files
